usage: jbus item approve [-h] --by BY [--where {chat,view,cli}]
                         [--words WORDS] [--seen SEEN]
                         id

positional arguments:
  id

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --by BY
  --where {chat,view,cli}
  --words WORDS         what was said, as it was said
  --seen SEEN           the last line of the item its writer saw
